If someone is ALWAYS caught up in some sort of drama then it's not because of everybody else.

People never fully recovered from the pandemic response.

Not just in terms of some people's health, but the economy, social and institutional trust, and overall mental wellbeing.

No questions were answered and there was never any accountability. So the loop is still open.

A significant % of Gen Z get 'anxiety' from talking on the phone, sustaining eye contact, cooking, driving, and other basic, everyday tasks.

Those who don't fall into this category will completely dominate those who do. They might end up being the most bifurcated generation.
A culture is in severe decline when condemning a sin is viewed as a greater sin than the sin itself.
Parts of Washington DC look exactly like London. Which makes sense, but it's still a trip.

Whenever I'm in the USA, I am shocked by how many 'churches' have giant rainbow flags hanging outside of them. 

It's like a sign of conquered territory.

Yes, psyops exist. Negative propaganda is everywhere. There are agendas to dumb you down, keep you fat, lonely, and broke, and to turn you against yourself and your neighbours.

You don't have to fall for them every time.

ABSENCE of masculinity is a much bigger social problem than so called 'toxic masculinity'.

And what people call 'toxic masculinity' is usually downstream of an absence of masculinity anyway.
